cohort: The cohort consisted of patients diagnosed with spontaneous, late preterm labour between 34 and 37 weeks of gestation, divided into preterm delivery (before 37 weeks) and term delivery (at or after 37 weeks) groups.
finding: High neutrophil to lymphocyte ratio (NLR) at admission is an independent predictor of preterm birth in patients with spontaneous, late preterm labour.
gest_age: Between 34 and 37 weeks of gestation (at presentation with threatened preterm labor)
